name: u0life AI Assistant
author: u0life

sections.description:
The official WordPress.org edition uses fixed WordPress actions:

  • read_context — return the project and component context;
  • query_posts, save_post, trash_post and replace_post_content — work with posts, pages, public custom post types and media records;
  • query_terms, save_term and assign_terms — work with public WordPress taxonomies;
  • import_media — import a safe staged attachment into the WordPress Media Library;
  • read_settings and update_settings — work with a small allowlist of public site settings;
  • upload_file — store a task attachment in the component inbox;
  • cleanup_task_files — remove temporary files for one task run.

The plugin does not expose arbitrary files, SQL, code execution, users, plugins, themes or unrestricted options. Files accepted for Media Library import are checked against a fixed safe MIME allowlist. For full owner-approved site access, use the separately installed Advanced edition documented at https://u0life.com/integrations/cms/wordpress-advanced/.

External service

This plugin connects to the u0life service only after an administrator enters a pairing code. The service is required to receive tasks and return their results.

During pairing and normal operation, the plugin may send the site URL, component and WordPress versions, PHP and database versions, site languages, installed plugin names and versions, task command results, and WordPress content explicitly involved in a task. Safe task attachments selected by the user may be transferred to the component and imported into the Media Library. No connection is made before the administrator pairs the site.

Service: https://u0life.com/
Privacy policy: https://u0life.com/info/privacy/
Terms: https://u0life.com/info/ordering_rules/

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress.org plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Settings → u0life AI Assistant.
  4. Paste a fresh pairing code from the u0life website project and connect.
